what: The Casio MT-40's riddim machine on the FM-1: the 28-riddim SLOOP Dub bank (the Sleng Teng at 82 BPM, the five other MT-40 rhythms), the MT-40 bass keyboard — one key re-roots the pattern live, its neighbours play minor or 7th — and the synchro start, over Felucca 1.8.2.
author: altessproduction
